entry_points.text: Three PIO tables expose master slave and ELCR windows delegating to shared logic.
One MMIO table exposes selector and window with base-range filter, low-8 select, selector low-8 retain, widths 1 2 4 8 with truncation and warn on others, serialized by lock.

Atomic set handles HyperV MSI-fast and Xen-fast ignoring deasserted else retry; IRQ-line ioctl needs in-kernel chip and returns status; chip ioctls select master slave IOAPIC by ID rejecting unknown and refreshing output.

Routing setup validates per type with PIC ranges and slave bias binding setters, MSI addr check, synth record, Xen delegate rejecting unknown; Xen setup records port CPU prio tolerating unknown CPU and skipping range checks.

exports.text: PIC and IOAPIC creation allocate per-VM state, init locks and notifiers, apply defaults, publish PIO 0x20 0xA0 0x4D0 len2 and MMIO window, unwind on conflict with failure.

Pin injection checks range, folds levels and forwards with coalesced status; scan refreshes EOI interception for level notifier RTC via accel or full scan, asserted MSI only, fixed dest change scans union else global.
Routing install validates GSIs flags, sizes from max, builds entries with reverse maps and publishes atomically; global irqfd refresh plus default install; x86 adds HyperV split, generic no-op.
Bypass attach records producer and starts vendor bypass with rollback on failure, detach reverts; irqfd refresh keeps routing only on singleton and reprograms posted state only on MSI changes.

Snapshot copies state filtering remote and replays pending under lock; timer inject fans to LAPIC Xen when enabled resetting counters and Xen expiry; migration moves LAPIC PIT vendor, skipping when not in-kernel or postable.
Irqfd permission needs full irqchip for resample else any in-kernel chip; presence and routing permission share the in-kernel test.

hazards.text: Non-single-byte PIC logs and ignores or zeroes, bad addresses unsupported; OOR pin warns once and fails; bad MMIO lengths warn without mutation.
Stale pending after masked level handling can extra-deliver without resampler; coalesced edge and RTC assertions suppress duplicates and report distinctly.
Restore discards prior pending delivered so outside locked changes lost; ack with bad vector or no LAPIC leaves state; extended-format MSI violations rejected not delivered.
Event retry needs sleepable cache refresh not success else dropped; borrowing VM memory with unrelated space rejected; poller wake only on matching port avoids spurious unblock.
Loss warnings suppressed when in-kernel PIC may consume or Xen enabled; detach warns on mismatch and remnants; illegal routing fails cleanly.

invariants.text: PIO dispatch routes low master and slave pairs and ELCR split by parity with len1 only; ELCR keeps per-chip lines 0xF8 0xDE and reads back retained value.

Reads expose version pins-1 in 16-23 ver low, ID nibble 24-31, paired halves OOR all-ones; writes ignore version, update ID nibble or half preserving delivery remote, clear remote on edge, announce mask; index sel-0x10 halved odd high; bound 10000.

Reset masks all, clears pending delivered selector ID base, cancels deferred work and reinits RTC; deferred reissues only pending unacked level; bulk resets RTC reasserts set restores; lazy EOI completes RTC on first dest without pending.
CPU timer pending sums LAPIC only when in-kernel enabled and unmasked plus Xen only when enabled with hypercall and positive counter.

Ack warns once and ignores missing state or bad vector, always clears request, refreshes priority for auto-EOI or sets service assuming no higher pending, updating SW caches else HW registers with duplicates ignored.

Fast event resolves CPU by cache or scan, rejects unknown CPU OOR port, validates shared area picking layout by long mode, sets pending as set masked delivered updating guest shadow kicking or injecting; sleeper retries borrowing space; poller wakes only on match.
MSI decodes routing address data to dest vector styles with asserted level and no shorthand; extended format with high bits set is invalid; invalid or deasserted rejected else delivered to LAPIC.

Posting allows only fixed lowest with single matching vCPU; shorthand bypasses cache, singleton may decide early, else full scan; needs in-kernel plus bypass, no-op when both absent else vendor hook records vCPU.
Default maps low GSIs to IOAPIC plus PIC with folding and higher legacy IOAPIC only; per-entry build allows one chip mapping per GSI and one non-chip mapping, records reverse map and links bucket.

locks.text: PIC paths hold PIC spin across port ops; IOAPIC paths hold IOAPIC spin across state access.
Bus publication and rollback for PIC and IOAPIC creation hold VM slots mutex, released before publishing success.
Routing readers use SRCU and APIC map readers RCU, publication under mutex with expedited quiescence; irqfd and producer state under IRQ-safe spin.
Mask chain uses SRCU traversal and IRQ lock mutation; Xen fast path holds sleepable protection and cache lock with IRQs saved, dropping across shared to per-CPU switch.

state_machines.text: Poll is one-shot where set flag diverts next read to delivery encoding 0x80 present versus 0x07 absent and clears request service cascade with refresh, else selector mask path without effects.

Level pin moves asserted pending to delivered with remote ack to EOI; deassert clears pending, edge and RTC coalescing suppress redelivery, unmask offers resampler first, deferred reissues pending unacked.
Bypass source rests detached, attaches remapped without eligible target, posts when MSI yields single postable vCPU, returns on change removal or failure.

Injectable when ext pending else hidden when nested virtualized else LAPIC pending; ext fetch without LAPIC returns stored else Xen PIC split once clearing to absent; overall prefers ext then LAPIC with ack.

structs.text: PIC pairs per-channel request mask service edge priority base mode sequencing plus back link with container holding lock wakeup ack count VM link master slave output devices and 16 levels.

IOAPIC holds base selector ID pending, table of 64-bit entries with vector delivery dest polarity remote trigger mask, line state, EOI history, RTC bitmap vectors counters work, delivered marker, notifiers, device, lock, VM link.

Fault record holds vector error nested async and qualification; decoded insn holds intercept prefix addressing values widths and addresses; emulate ops group state memory IO segment register MSR halt CPUID hooks, partial.
IOAPIC pins alias KVM count, ver 0x11, edge0 level1, base 0xFEC00000 span 0x100, sel 0x00 win 0x10, ver reg 0x01, fixed0 lowest1 NMI4 INIT5, RTC line8.
Emulation outcomes 0 continue 1 unhandleable 2 propagate 3 retry 4 cmpxchg-failed 5 io-needed 6 intercepted 7 vectoring; flags write0 fetch1 implicit2 invlpg3 msr4 dtload5.
